title: Brown-Butter Orzo With Butternut Squash
description: A creamy, risotto-like orzo dish with roasted butternut squash, brown butter, sage, and parmesan, finished with lemon for brightness.

steps.instruction: Melt butter in a large pot or skillet over medium heat and cook until browned and nutty.
Add shallots and cook until softened.
Add butternut squash, sage, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes, and cook until squash begins to soften and brown.
Add stock and bring to a simmer.
Stir in orzo, lemon zest, and salt. Cover and simmer until orzo is tender and most liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese.
Adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve topped with ricotta (if using), extra parmesan, herbs, and red pepper flakes.
